question: Who were the flag bearers in the opening ceremony of the Asian Games 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harmanpreet Singh and Lovlina Borgohain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Harmanpreet Singh**, the captain of the Indian men’s hockey team, and **Lovlina Borgohain**, an Olympic medal-winning boxer, were the flag bearers for India at the opening ceremony of the **Asian Games 2023**.
 
• The opening ceremony of the Asian Games 2023 took place on **23rd September 2023** in Hangzhou, China.
 
• The decision to select these athletes reflects their significant achievements and contributions to Indian sports on the global stage.
 
• This marked a proud moment for India as these two athletes represented the spirit and excellence of the country at the prestigious event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Games:** The Asian Games, also known as Asiad, is a continental multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from across Asia.
 
• **Harmanpreet Singh:** He is an accomplished hockey player and has been instrumental in the success of the Indian men’s hockey team, including their bronze medal win at the Tokyo Olympics.
 
• **Lovlina Borgohain:** She is an Indian boxer who won a bronze medal in the women’s welterweight event at the Tokyo Olympics, making her one of India’s top-performing athletes.
 
• **Opening Ceremony:** The opening ceremony of the Asian Games is a grand event that showcases the culture, tradition, and spirit of sportsmanship of the host country.
 
• **India at Asian Games:** India has been a consistent participant in the Asian Games since its inception in 1951, with achievements across various sports disciplines.
